book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Nginyika ya kukamula Yecho
Unyagho gwa mabumunda ghangaleke ngedule, jhikemitwa Pachaka piheghelila.
Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhapaliya ndela jha kinyemela jha kunkoma Yecho, nambo bhajhogwipa bhando.
Yuda ijheketela kunnyambila Yecho
Bhahe, Limbembela lijhakunyingilila Yuda, jwakemitwa Isikaliyote, ndi jhumo jwa bhabholwa bhake bhala kome na bhabhele.
Yuda ajhakujhenda kwa akapiya matambiko bhakolo na akalonda Nyumba jha Chapanga, ajhakulonge nabho ndela jha kunnyambii Yecho.
Bhene bhajhakuhanganila hake na kulaghalana na Yuda nabhampela mbijha kwa lihengo lyenio.
Yuda ajhakujheketila, peniya ndi patumbwila kupalaha ndela jhamaha jha kunnyambila Yecho, lilongo lya bhando changamanya.
Yecho ilenganikiya chakulya cha unyagho gwa Pachaka
Bhahe, lichiko lya mabumunda ghangalekela ngedule pulihikita. Lichiko lyenio ndi lichiko lya kuchinja katole kalimbelele kakulye pa Unyagho gwa Pachaka.
Peniya Yecho ajhakwatuma Petile na Yohane, ajhakwalobholela, “Nnyendengane mukatulinganikiye chakulye Pachaka.”
Bhahe, na bhene pubhankonyita, “Mipala tujhende kojhe tukalenganikiye?”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Unyokanikiye, pumujhingila pabomane nankongana na likambako jwatwekile kihulo cha mache. Jwenio ndi mukengemila ade munyumba jhajhingila.
Nkolo nyumba munnobholela, ‘Mmola ankonya, chumbi cha akaghene kibhii kojhe, chakulyegha Pachaka pamonga na bhabholwa bhango?’
Jwenio nanangiya chumbi kikolongwa cha ku gholofa chikikilimwe mbone, nnenganikila mwenio.”
Bhahe, bhajhakujhenda, na kukikolela kila kilebhe telatela ngita chabhalaghalikiye Yecho, na bhene ndi pibhatumbwila kulenganikiya chakulye Pachaka.
Chakulya cha Bhambo
Lichaa lya kulyegha puliikita, Yecho ajhakwatola akatenga bhake na kutama nako kulyegha.
Ajhakwalobholela bheniya, “Noghii hake kulye Pachaka pamonga na mangota, kabula jha mang'ahiko ghango.
Ninnobholela chakaka, nilye ndeka kabhele ade puipala kulenganikiya mu Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga.”
Yecho ajhakutola kibaba cha divaye, na kunchenguu Chapanga, alongila, “Mmaghana mabhoha.
Ninobholela, kutumbulii ngohe, nanywe jhe kabhele divaye jhenje, ade Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga pala puupala kuhika.”
Bhahe, ajhakutola libumunda, ajhakunchenguu Chapanga, ajhakumetula na kwabhaghanichila, alongila, “Jhenjeno ndi yegha jhipelwa mangota. Ntenda naha kwa kungomboka nenga.”
Helahela akatei ndalilo, “Ajhakwapekeha kibaba cha divaye alongela, chenjeno ndi kibaba cha lilaghano liyono lya Chapanga lilijhemelelwa na miyahe jhango, jhijhitika kwa nhwalo gwino mangota.
“Nambo, umanye! Mundo jwambala kunyambila nenga minako pakiheneko pano!
Chakaka Mwana gwa Mundo nahwa ngita chilengankilwe, nambo nalola choto mundo jhola jwapala kunnyambila!”
Bhajhakutumbula kukonyana achi bhene chika, ndi ghane pakate jhito jwahipala kuhenga kilebhe chenie.
Mitaongano ghane nkolongwa
Helahela bhabholwa bhake Yecho bhajhakutumbula mitabho pakate jhabhe ghane jwaholelelwa kubhehe nkolongwa kuliku bhange.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Akanahota akakolonga bha bhando bha ilambo henge ubhalongocha bhando kwa makakala, na bhala bhina ukolonga ukitina liina lya ‘Akakoche bha bhando.’
Nambo mangota ghakotoka kulandana na bheniya. Nambo jwabhii nkolongwa pakate jhino abhaha jwandina kuliku bhoha, na kilongoche abhaha mundo jwabhahengela bhoha.
Bho, ndi ghane jwabhii nkolongwa? Bho, jwaitama pakulyegha amu jwalenganikiya chakulyegha? Chakaka jhola jwaitama pakulyegha. Nambo nenga mii pakate jhino ngita natumiche.”
“Mangota ndi bhuhighalike pamonga na nenga mumang'ahiko ghango.”
Ngita Tate, chahagwii nenga kulongocha ngita munahota nkolongwa, na nenga nipelingine mangota hele unahota nkolongwa.
Peniya, nanyakila na kunomenekeya pamonga munahota nkolongwa gwango na kutama muigoda ya unahota nkolongwa na kulongocha makabila kome na mabhele gha Ichilahele.
Yecho ilotela Petile natenda kukana
Yecho palongila, “Ma Simone, Ma Simone! Jhokanikiya! Limbembela apala kunyembeluya ngita mponga.
Nambo nenga ninyope mwenga Simone, hilu kihobholelo chino kikotoka kuhokeka. Na mwenga pumpala kumujhila kabhele matangatila akalongo bhino.”
Petile ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, nanjino nyeketile kupungwa na mwenga amu bhatukoma tugha pamonga kilebhe jhe!”
Yecho ngalongila, “Ninnobholela ma Petile, lijhogholo nakubhekajhe naunganila patato.”
Mukilenganikiye na machiko gha mang'ahiko
Peniya Yecho ajhakwakonya bhabholwa bhake, “Bho, punitumingina changaghegha mbijha amu lihako amu changahwala maghubache nike mukapongokiwe?” Bhajhakujhanguu, “Tukapongokiwe ndeka kilebhe.”

Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nambo kutumbuli ngoheno, mundo jwabhii na mbijha aghegha, na jwabhii na lihako helahela aghegha. Na jhola jwanga mbopo akachuluche ngobho yake na ajhende akahemela mbopo jhimo.

Nhwalo ghabhii lengalenga mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, ‘Na jwenio nabhalangilwa pamonga na bhando bhibhatenda ghanganandela.’ Ninnobholela ghoha ghughajhandikwe kwa nhwalo gwa nenga ghapile ghapitile.”
Bhabholwa bhake ngabhanongolila, “Bhambo, dola pambano ibhii mbopo ibhele.” Jwenio Yecho ngajhangwila, “Bhahe, ikwela!”
Yecho inyopa Chapanga ku Kitombe chuku Micheitune
Yecho ajhakubhoka ngita chakayobhalile, na kujhenda ku kitombe chuku Micheitune na bhabholwa bhake bhajhakubhehe pamonga.
Pubhahikita kwenio, ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, “Munyopengane Chapanga, nkotoka kujhingii mumajhighanikilo.”
Peniya ajhakwaleka, na kujhenda kutale ngita mundo ajhuhite lighanga kuliponile. Na kutama makilikite anyopa Chapanga,
alongila, “Ma Tate, anda mipala umokehe kibaba chenjeno cha malagho. Nambo chi ngita chinipala nenga, nambo ngita chimipala mabhene.”
Bhahe, ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga, ajhakupitila na kukangamalicha.
Yecho nhwalo akibha mulipyanda, ajhakunyopa hake Chapanga. Lihuke lyake likibha ngita mandonye gha miyahe ghahololila pahe.
Pajhomolila kunnyopa Chapanga, ajhakwajhendela bhabholwa bhake. Ajhakwakolela bhagholwike, nhwalo gwa ungolongonde.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nhwalo gwa nike migholoka? Jhimukana munyopengane Chapanga, nkotoka kujhingii mumajhighanikilo.”
Yecho ikamulwa
Pajhendilila kulonge, lilongo lya bhando lijhakupitila kongo lilongochwa na Yuda, jwakibha jhumo jwa bhabholwa bhake bhala kome na bhabhele. Ajhakuheghelela Yecho na kunkumbatila.
Nambo Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Yuda, nhwalo gwa nike munyambi Mwana gwa Mundo kwa kunkumbatila?”
Bhabholwa bhake bhala bhalolikiya ghughapala kupitila bhajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, bho, twapyeke kwa mbopo?”
Jhumo pakate jhabhe ajhakuntyala ntumiche jwa Mpiya litambiko nkolo, na kuheketa lichikilo lyake lya lubhoko lwalelo.
Nambo Yecho palongila, “Nkoto kuhenga kabhele!” Ajhakupapaa lichikilo lya mundo jhola, ajhakulama.

Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na ilongoche ya ulonda gwa Nyumba jha Chapanga na ighogholo bhubhakahikite kunkamula, “Bho, uhikingine na indukwa na mbopo, pimihambuka nenga nipoka ilebhe kwa makakala?
Machiko ghoha ndamita na mangota mwenga pa Nyumba jha Chapanga mukangamwi ndeka. Nambo lende ndi lichaa lya makakala gha lubhendo, kulongocha.”
Petile ikanii Yecho
Peniya bhajhakunkamula Yecho na kujhenda nako ade ku nyumba jha Mpiya litambiko nkolo. Petile akengemila kachoko chukutale.
Pakate jha mulwane lwa nyumba bhakakungine mwotu, na bhoha bhajhakutamangana peniya kujhota, na jwenio Petile akibha pakate jhabhe.
Ntumiche jhumo mwikeghe pamonita Petile aheghelii pahina jha mwotu, ajhakuningukiya na kulonge, “Mundo hojho chakaka akibha pamonga na Yecho!”
Nambo Petile ajhakunkanila, alongila, “Gwe majhe, niumanyite jwenio!”
Machaa pughachochita kujhenda, mundo jhonge, ajhakubhona Petile na jwenio ngalongila, “Mwenga ndi jhumo pakate jhabhe!” Nambo Petile pajhangwila, “Munahota, ne ndeka!”
Lichaa limo pulipetita, mundo jhonge ajhakupitila na kulonge helahela, “Chakaka mundo jhonjo bhahwelita pamonga na jwenio, helahela ahumii ku Galilaya!”
Nambo Petile pajhangwila, “Gwe mundo, chimulongela nikimanyi ndeka!” Palongela gheniya, lijhogholo lijhakubheka.
Bhambo Yecho ajhakughalambukila na kunnolekeya Petile. Peniya ndi Petile pakombwika malobhe ghalongila Bhambo ghala, “Deleno lijhogholo na kubhekajhe, naungannila patato.”
Petile ajhakupita panja jha ubhegho na kulela kwa ungolongonde.
Yecho bhitende chanake na kukong'ondwa
Bhando bhubhanendelila Yecho bhala, bhajhakuntende chanake na bhajhakuntyala.
Bhahibhite miho kwa kitambala, kone bhankonyita, “Nnotele! Bho, ghane jwatyalite?”
Peniya bhajhakulonge malobhe twe gha kunigha.
Yecho bhipeleka palonge jha bwalo
Pukuchila tugha, ighogholo na akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhajhakukonganika pamonga, bhajhakumpeleka Yecho pa bwalo jha Kiyahude.
Ngabhannobhalila, “Bho, mutulobholele, mwenga ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche?” Nambo Yecho ngabhajhangwila, “Hilu ninnobholele, mangota naunyangula jhe.
Anda nikonyite, naunyangula ndeka.
Nambo kutumbuli ngoheno na kujhendelela, Mwana gwa Mundo natama lubhoko lwalelo lwa Chapanga jwabhii na makakala.”
Peniya bhoha bhajhakunkonya, “Bho, mwenga ndi Mwana gwa Chapanga?” Jwenio Yecho ngabhajhangwila, “Chakaka, ngita chimulongela.”
Bhene bhajhakulonge, “Bho, tupala mundo jhonge alonge panane jha mambu ghake? Twabhete tujhohine malobhe ghalongila jwenio!”
